findings.issue: דָּרַךְ is qal perfect 3ms with no object; כּוֹכָב is the masculine singular subject and מִן marks origin. Transitive «Pisó estrella» makes the star the thing trodden by an unnamed subject.
שֵׁבֶט stays open among rod, staff, tribe, and scepter; «cetro» narrows it to a specialized royal instrument.
פַּאֲתֵי is feminine dual construct of a lemma open to side, corner, or edge; «sienes» is an unmarked plural and narrows it to anatomical temples.
מוֹאָב is a proper name with the conventional Spanish form Moab. Moav hebraizes the soft bet.
שֵׁת is a proper name with the conventional Spanish form Set. Shet hebraizes the shin.

notes: Lo veo / no ahora / lo miro / no cercano, se levantó desde Israel, traspasó, and destrozó a todos hijos match person, stem, suffix, and the pilpel object.
